derivative_notice: Public derivative of the named original accepted receipts. It selects and reformats their accepted facts; it is not a byte-identical copy of either original. Originals remain unchanged.

method.installed_source_comparison: Compared canonical payload hashes and sizes, exact source/native files, ordered bindings and source-status claims against independently accepted frozen packets and approved metadata addenda.
method.central_closure: Bound final retention and containment owners to the exact independently accepted ledger and source-owner freeze; preserved historical decisions and public disclosure boundaries.
method.prior_evidence_reuse: Existing source-library and focused containment validation, independent source-word collation and extent evidence were reused by exact identity. No full graph, old-payload baseline or source-image collation was repeated.
method.derivative_preparation: Read accepted receipt and inventory metadata only. No payload rehash, source research, code/data change or new validation is represented by this derivative.

compact_binding_digest.serialization: UTF-8 JSON array; rows sorted by path; object keys sorted; comma/colon separators without spaces; non-ASCII unescaped; no trailing newline.

central_retention.count_limit: Counts describe source-byte retention decisions, not distinct books or substantive versions.

containment.scope: New exclusions cover the single-missal 1657 image ZIP and indirect directory; no anthology, second work or whole-book completeness is inferred.

cistercian1606.declared_extent: Strict Canon from its opening heading through final Per omnia/Amen, before Oremus; all printed seasonal forms and governing rubrics included.
cistercian1606.source_acquisition: Complete 415-page provider PDF acquired and hashed; its 672254859 bytes are remote-only canonical metadata. The eight-page retained facsimile is a lossless bounded extraction.

rights.source_images: Recorded BSB No Copyright - Non-Commercial Use Only 1.0 condition and attribution retained; a rights statement, not a Creative Commons licence.

cistercian1657.declared_extent: Seven proper Canon forms with governing headings and rubrics on printed pages 176, 177, 181, 183 and 184; original source order retained, followed by Canon title/Crucifixion and main Canon on pages 203-213 through final Amen and adjacent Iungit manus, before Oremus.

preface_census.scope: All other preface text, chant and rubrics excluded from this declared constituent.

cistercian1657.source_acquisition: Dated 17 October receipt documents 740 separately delivered native pages. The original review matched the 40 newly retained native pages and 813-byte indirect directory to that receipt; it did not rehash all 740 pages. The directory is not embedded whole-book imagery.

native_dependency.status: Existing exact companion reused for all retained INCL references.

cistercian1657.derivative_limit: Reader JPEGs are explicitly lossy; the PDF preserves those exact JPEG streams, not original native DjVu pixels or photographic masters.

rights.historical_latin_and_faithful_mechanical: Recorded United States public-domain basis and exact FIDES holding/rights/access facts.
rights.modern_provider_html: Whole wrapper redistribution basis unestablished; deferred. Public control data contains selected facts and delivery identity only.

duplicate_review_rasters.limit: Exact native parents retained; bit-identical recreation of old intermediate raster wrappers is not promised.

native_source_scope.stage_binding_limit: Each Cistercian stage has two separately complete constituents, offertory and Canon; whole-book coverage remains partial.

armenian_scope.identity: Distinct Rome 1677 FSL A/711 setting; liturgy ends at printed 19, followed by an unnumbered blank and corrections 21-30. It does not replace the Google 20-page setting or Ministerium.
armenian_scope.reuse_scope: Stated noncommercial research source repository/ZIP, free noncommercial PDF/display and internal noncommercial research, with recorded attribution, source/licence links and change notices.
armenian_scope.required_credit: FSL Yerevan original holder and digitizer, British Library EAP delivery, EAP/Arcadia funding; no endorsement.

lineage_limit.scope: Edition-level republication only; no whole-book genealogy or identified physical donor copy.

disclosure.legacy_relative_research_locators: Inherited unchanged; no new private operational locator published.
disclosure.provider_wrapper_and_transport_boundary: Modern whole HTML wrapper stays deferred. Public control facts omit its private local locator; raw transport headers and cookies remain excluded.
disclosure.project_license_boundary: Each source retains its recorded public-domain, permission or licence basis; project licensing does not override third-party terms.
